notablePrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
description:
Cast Quarry Hauler by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Myojin by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Quarry Hauler spell three times.
Resolve the first Quarry Hauler spell.
When the Quarry Hauler token enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin.
Repeat from step 2.
